issues.title: The current CUDA channel-mix kernel does not compile for sm_89
issues.detail: The published one-GPU MiniPile path imports rwkv7_cmix_bf16_v5 during initialization. On an NVIDIA L40S, nvcc targets sm_89 and rejects atomicAdd(reinterpret_cast<float2*>(ptr), make_float2(...)) because that vector overload is unavailable for this architecture. Initialization stops before a model or loss can be produced.
issues.fix: provide an sm_89-compatible accumulation implementation, such as architecture-gated scalar float atomics

experimentUrlNote: The upstream WandB path was enabled and the hosted bridge initialized, but the CUDA compilation failure occurred before the first training batch and before wandb.init(), so no metric-bearing run exists.

certification.resultCaveat: No DAG was published because the upstream CUDA extension failed before training; the row is blocked and is not a Reproducible record or a Certified reproduction.
